blocks.text: Several kinds of formula are used to represent organic compounds.

items: Molecular formula: the actual number of atoms of each element in one molecule, e.g. butane C4H10, ethanoic (acetic) acid C2H4O2, ethanol C2H6O. It does not show how the atoms are joined, so different compounds can share one: ethanol and methoxymethane are both C2H6O.
Empirical formula: the smallest whole-number ratio of the atoms of each element, e.g. butane (C4H10) is C2H5 and ethanoic acid (C2H4O2) is CH2O.
Structural formula: shows the sequence in which the atoms are joined as well as their numbers.
Displayed (graphical) formula: shows every bond between the atoms, including the type of bond and the position of the functional groups.

blocks.alt: Displayed formulae with every bond drawn: butane, four C in a row with three H on each end carbon and two H on each middle carbon; ethanol, H-C-C-OH with two H above and below each carbon; ethanoic acid, H3C drawn with three H, joined to a C that has a double bond to O and a single bond to O-H.
blocks.caption: Displayed formulae of butane, ethanol and ethanoic acid (original drawing after the textbook's unnumbered figure).

items: Condensed (linear) formula: the displayed formula written on one line; single bonds are left out, while branches, functional groups, multiple bonds and repeated CH2 groups are shown, e.g. CH3(CH2)2CH3 (butane), CH3CH2OH (ethanol), CH3COOH (ethanoic acid).

Skeletal (bond-line) formula: the symbols of carbon and hydrogen and the C-H bonds are removed. Carbon-carbon bonds are lines meeting at angles; each corner or line end is a carbon with enough H atoms to make four bonds. Double and triple bonds and functional groups are shown, e.g. ethanol is a short line with OH at one end.

blocks.alt: Four rows, each with a name, a condensed formula and a skeletal formula: (i) butane, CH3-CH2-CH2-CH3, a zigzag of three lines; (ii) ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, two lines ending in OH; (iii) methoxymethane, CH3-O-CH3, two lines meeting at an O; (iv) ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-OH, a line to a corner with a double line up to O and a line down to OH.
blocks.caption: Condensed and skeletal formulae of butane, ethanol, methoxymethane and ethanoic acid (original drawing after the textbook's unnumbered figure).
